summary: Unused CatalogGenerationStore remains and its core tests do not exercise Android storage; test suite may give false confidence.
claim: Misleading test coverage; unused code may hide gaps or confuse maintenance.

evidence.source: core evidence includes CatalogGenerationStoreTest (2 tests) but no app source reference to CatalogGenerationStore; StorageAcceptanceTest is separate and does not cover it.

suggested_remediation: Remove unused CatalogGenerationStore or add Android storage test that directly validates real database behavior.
suggested_validation: Codebase has no unused catalog generation store in app path; Android storage tests are sole coverage.
